assets.name: vercel-react-best-practices
assets.description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.

assets.name: _sections
assets.description: This file defines all sections, their ordering, impact levels, and descriptions.

assets.name: _template
assets.description: **Impact: MEDIUM (optional impact description)**

assets.name: advanced-event-handler-refs
assets.description: Store callbacks in refs when used in effects that shouldn't re-subscribe on callback changes.

assets.name: advanced-use-latest
assets.description: Access latest values in callbacks without adding them to dependency arrays. Prevents effect re-runs while avoiding stale closures.

assets.name: async-api-routes
assets.description: In API routes and Server Actions, start independent operations immediately, even if you don't await them yet.

assets.name: async-defer-await
assets.description: Move `await` operations into the branches where they're actually used to avoid blocking code paths that don't need them.

assets.name: async-dependencies
assets.description: For operations with partial dependencies, use `better-all` to maximize parallelism. It automatically starts each task at the earliest possible moment.

assets.name: async-parallel
assets.description: When async operations have no interdependencies, execute them concurrently using `Promise.all()`.

assets.name: async-suspense-boundaries
assets.description: Instead of awaiting data in async components before returning JSX, use Suspense boundaries to show the wrapper UI faster while data loads.

assets.name: bundle-barrel-imports
assets.description: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files to avoid loading thousands of unused modules. **Barrel files** are entry points that re-export multiple modules (e.g., `index.js` that does `export * from './module'`).

assets.name: bundle-conditional
assets.description: Load large data or modules only when a feature is activated.

assets.name: bundle-defer-third-party
assets.description: Analytics, logging, and error tracking don't block user interaction. Load them after hydration.

assets.name: bundle-dynamic-imports
assets.description: Use `next/dynamic` to lazy-load large components not needed on initial render.

assets.name: bundle-preload
assets.description: Preload heavy bundles before they're needed to reduce perceived latency.

assets.name: client-event-listeners
assets.description: Use `useSWRSubscription()` to share global event listeners across component instances.

assets.name: client-swr-dedup
assets.description: SWR enables request deduplication, caching, and revalidation across component instances.

assets.name: js-batch-dom-css
assets.description: Avoid changing styles one property at a time. Group multiple CSS changes together via classes or `cssText` to minimize browser reflows.

assets.name: js-cache-function-results
assets.description: Use a module-level Map to cache function results when the same function is called repeatedly with the same inputs during render.

assets.name: js-cache-property-access
assets.description: Cache object property lookups in hot paths.

assets.name: js-cache-storage
assets.description: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `document.cookie` are synchronous and expensive. Cache reads in memory.

assets.name: js-combine-iterations
assets.description: Multiple `.filter()` or `.map()` calls iterate the array multiple times. Combine into one loop.

assets.name: js-early-exit
assets.description: Return early when result is determined to skip unnecessary processing.

assets.name: js-hoist-regexp
assets.description: Don't create RegExp inside render. Hoist to module scope or memoize with `useMemo()`.

assets.name: js-index-maps
assets.description: Multiple `.find()` calls by the same key should use a Map.

assets.name: js-length-check-first
assets.description: When comparing arrays with expensive operations (sorting, deep equality, serialization), check lengths first. If lengths differ, the arrays cannot be equal.

assets.name: js-min-max-loop
assets.description: Finding the smallest or largest element only requires a single pass through the array. Sorting is wasteful and slower.

assets.name: js-set-map-lookups
assets.description: Convert arrays to Set/Map for repeated membership checks.

assets.name: js-tosorted-immutable
assets.description: `.sort()` mutates the array in place, which can cause bugs with React state and props. Use `.toSorted()` to create a new sorted array without mutation.

assets.name: rendering-activity
assets.description: Use React's `<Activity>` to preserve state/DOM for expensive components that frequently toggle visibility.

assets.name: rendering-animate-svg-wrapper
assets.description: Many browsers don't have hardware acceleration for CSS3 animations on SVG elements. Wrap SVG in a `<div>` and animate the wrapper instead.

assets.name: rendering-conditional-render
assets.description: Use explicit ternary operators (`? :`) instead of `&&` for conditional rendering when the condition can be `0`, `NaN`, or other falsy values that render.

assets.name: rendering-content-visibility
assets.description: Apply `content-visibility: auto` to defer off-screen rendering.

assets.name: rendering-hoist-jsx
assets.description: Extract static JSX outside components to avoid re-creation.

assets.name: rendering-hydration-no-flicker
assets.description: When rendering content that depends on client-side storage (localStorage, cookies), avoid both SSR breakage and post-hydration flickering by injecting a synchronous script that updates the DOM before React hydrates.

assets.name: rendering-svg-precision
assets.description: Reduce SVG coordinate precision to decrease file size. The optimal precision depends on the viewBox size, but in general reducing precision should be considered.

assets.name: rerender-defer-reads
assets.description: Don't subscribe to dynamic state (searchParams, localStorage) if you only read it inside callbacks.

assets.name: rerender-dependencies
assets.description: Specify primitive dependencies instead of objects to minimize effect re-runs.

assets.name: rerender-derived-state
assets.description: Subscribe to derived boolean state instead of continuous values to reduce re-render frequency.

assets.name: rerender-functional-setstate
assets.description: **Incorrect (requires state as dependency):**

assets.name: rerender-lazy-state-init
assets.description: Pass a function to `useState` for expensive initial values. Without the function form, the initializer runs on every render even though the value is only used once.

assets.name: rerender-memo
